attacks.name: Long sword
attacks.notes: Mastery: Sap. If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

resources.name: Lucky
resources.notes:
Advantage. When you roll a d20 for a D20 Test, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on the roll.

Disadvantage. When a creature rolls a d20 for an attack roll against you, you can spend 1 Luck Point to impose Disadvantage on that roll.

resources.name: Lay on Hands
resources.notes:
As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature (which could be yourself) and draw power from the pool of healing to restore a number of Hit Points to that creature, up to the maximum amount remaining in the pool.

You can also expend 5 Hit Points from the pool of healing power to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature; those points don't also restore Hit Points to the creature.

equipment.name: Amulet (Spellcasting Focus)
equipment.notes: An Amulet given to me by my mother before she passed.

equipment.name: Priest's Pack
equipment.notes: A Priest's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Blanket, Holy Water, Lamp, 7 days of Rations, Robe, and Tinderbox.

equipment.name: Perfume
equipment.notes: Perfume comes in a 4-ounce vial. For 1 hour after applying Perfume to yourself, you have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to influence an Indifferent Humanoid within 5 feet of yourself.

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.notes:
Casting Time: Bonus action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
Range: Self
Components: V
Duration: Instantaneous

The target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.notes:
Casting Time: Bonus action
Range: 60 feet
Components: V, S, M (a prayer scroll)
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes

A shimmering field surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

notes.profLang:
Weapon Proficiencies: Simple and Martial weapons
Armor Training: Light, Medium, and Heavy armor and Shields
notes.features: Resourceful. You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.
notes.personality: Gets panicked easily. Loses track of stuff quickly. But really wants to be helpful.
notes.backstory:
My mother died when I was young. It hit me pretty hard, but it hit nobody as hard as it hit my father. He set out in the the world. The best paladin of Vengeance, they called him. Now I'm 17 and my father passed in battle as well. All my life I've been taken care by servants in our manor. But now that my father has passed, I can no longer pay to stay here. I set out into the world in my father's old armor and weapons. 

I may have trained from a young age. I am in no way prepared for being an adventurer. Let's see how the story unfolds.
